description: Checks the details for a case handled by the SOS Flights team (rebooking help, hotel, evidence and follow-up) and returns what will be submitted, the price (a one-time fee, or covered by a valid access code) and a confirmation_token valid for 15 minutes. Nothing is created or charged. No account is needed.

access_code.description: Prepaid access code, for example from OneYear Protection.

channel.description: How the team talks to the traveller, as the traveller chose: whatsapp, or chat in this assistant conversation and on the case page.

email.description: Traveller's email for the payment receipt and case updates.

lang.description: Language for the payment and case pages. Defaults to en.

phone.description: Traveller's mobile number with country code, for example +421905123456. The WhatsApp number, or an urgent contact for chat.

situation_summary.description: Summary for the team: airport, number of travellers and children's ages, what happened, flight number and booking reference, destination and urgency, constraints, any safety risk.

name: sos_prepare_case
title: Prepare an SOS Flights case
